thread:
alex: Noticed strange spike on p99 for /v1/generate around 17:12. p50 steady, p95 nudged, but p99 doubled. Dashboard shows origin switching to backup. Anyone able to confirm?
mei: Confirmed. Quota policy forced fallback at 17:12:06 and the dashboard sample_count for that minute dropped to ~320.
raj: FYI I pulled raw events from the rollup store. The rollup merged tdigest blobs from multiple origins without annotating origin counts -> merged p99 looks biased.
tom: Ugh, that explains it. Small cohorts with heavier tails will dominate high-percentiles after naive merges.
telemetry-bot: Rollup merge event: route=/v1/generate, merge_window=1m, origins_merged=2, primary_samples=7800, backup_samples=320, merge_method=tdigest_concat
alex: Proposed quick fixes: (a) UI shows sample_count next to each percentile, (b) badge that flips red if sample_count < 500, (c) provenance toggle that splits the time series by origin. Low effort + high value.
mei: Backend fix required too: store per-origin tdigest summaries as separate bundles and only do a provenance-aware merge at query/display time. That way we can compute p99 per-origin and a merged p99 but show confidence.
raj: Agreed. Also add a deterministic merge flag: merge_by='origin' or merge_by='time' so consumers can choose.
tom: UX nit: instead of hiding p99, we should show it with an explicit "low confidence" icon and dashed line. Hiding surprises folks.
alex: Good point. Tooltip copy suggestion: "High-percentile values are unreliable with low sample counts. See provenance toggle to inspect origins"
telemetry-bot: Incident note: quota fallback triggered by policy=quota_safety_v2 at 2024-04-16T17:12:06Z
raj: Quick diagnostic query I ran against the raw table:
```
-- pseudo-SQL
SELECT minute, quantileExact(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99, count() AS samples, origin
FROM route_latency_events
WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND ts BETWEEN '2024-04-16 17:10' AND '2024-04-16 17:15'
GROUP BY minute, origin
ORDER BY minute, origin;
```
raj: Results: primary p99=230ms samples=7800; backup p99=1150ms samples=320; merged naive p99=980ms samples=8120 -> explains the jump.
mei: Action items: 1) eng-platform backend: persist per-origin tdigest bundles (ENG-4599) 2) console: add sample_count badge + provenance toggle + dashed low-confidence rendering (PR spike welcome) 3) telemetry-tests: e2e that simulates origin shift and asserts UI shows confidence badge.
tom: I'll draft the UI mock and tooltip copy.
alex: I'll open ENG-4599 and link a console PR skeleton. Also add a temporary alert: page if p99_delta > 200ms and sample_count < 500.
console-bot: Created issue ENG-4599: "per-origin rollup bundles + UI provenance" assigned to eng-platform.
mei: One more thought: we should expose a "merge_confidence" metric (0..1) for each percentile in the API so other clients (not just console) can decide.
raj: Good idea. We can compute that from effective sample entropy / cohort variance heuristics.
alex: OK team, prioritize ENG-4599 this sprint? This is a customer-facing reliability UX gap.
tom: +1 from me. I'll pair with raj for backend contract.
mei: I'll add the e2e test scenario to telemetry-tests.
raj: Will update rollup schema PR and a compat migration plan.
alex: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up in ENG-4599 with concrete milestones. :thumbsup:
